Name: Iron Watch Commander
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward

Stat Blocks.title: Iron Watch Commander
languages: two other languages (usually Elvish and Gnomish)

traits.name: Brave Face
traits.description: The commander has advantage on saving throws made to resist being frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The commander makes three Longsword attacks or two Heavy Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage or 9 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Field Command
bonus_actions.description: Three soldiers that can hear the commander and aren’t incapacitated can use their reaction to move up to half their movement speed and/or make a single weapon attack against targets the commander designates.

bonus_actions.name: Manacles (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: If the commander is grappling a humanoid creature, or adjacent to one that is incapacitated or stunned, they can attempt to manacle them. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be manacled.
